description: EXPLORATORY (bean t7qv): acts on the owner's steer that negative NF coefficients are backwards in computational time — the inverse-crossing / entanglement sector, per jet_history_retention_probe §Q3 — and restricts the operator-selection program to x >= 0. This BREAKS the obstruction h3a_frobenius_gram_offdiagonal identified: because b_1 = 1, t = G e_1 and row 1 of Gx >= u is the objective itself, so it was always the binding row and no demand could select. With x >= 0 the optimum can no longer reach that bound (obj > u_1 at every nucleus), and the program becomes a genuine covering LP (t and G both entrywise positive). The net constraint must be dropped — it makes the positive sector infeasible, and prop:operator-selection-lp proves y_0* = 0 identically so it carries no information. RESULT: all four objectives distinct and T vs He3 get DIFFERENT supports (6 vs 9) — the separation Gap #2 needs, which no previous route produced. The optimal support uses only sigma_1, L+, L- as tensor factors; gamma, sigma_0 and e- never appear. TENSION flagged: x_free itself has 108 of 216 negative coordinates, so positivity is imposed on the solution while the demand comes from an object violating it. No fit; no B_AME anywhere; nothing wired.
caveats: x_free is NOT in the positive sector — 108 of 216 coordinates negative at A=3, because the nucleon NF carries sigma_1^{-1} letters. Positivity is imposed on the solution while the demand u = G x_free is built from an object that violates it. Rebuilding the nucleon in the positive sector would change every number here; not attempted.

Dropping the net constraint is load-bearing: with it retained the positive sector is infeasible at every A tested. The justification is prop:operator-selection-lp's own result that y_0* = 0 identically, so the constraint carries no shadow price — not that dropping it is convenient.

NOT SHOWN: that the selected operator is K; that the support is stable under q; that the objective value is physically meaningful. The demand comes from LR branching of the nucleon words and nothing empirical enters, so this is a structural result only.
